title: Help content for GIANT CS2CT
bodyHtml:
Video walkthrough of the CS2CT tool

Highlighting variants across sections

  • You may highlight one or more variants to keep track of their positions across the sections of the page. 
    • To highlight a variant, click on a star icon in the first column of a data table. 
    • All variants in a table can be also highlighted by hovering over the star icon on a table header and selecting Star or unstar all. 
  • The positions of starred variants will be marked on the association plot in the Variants in CS region section and on the region track in the Enriched regions section.
  • The positions of variants across the plot and tracks are marked with dotted lines that are color-coded by the section of the page in which you starred the variant. The legend for the color codes appears under the left side of the association plot.

Summary section

This section allows you to generate a downloadable table summarizing the results from your search.

  • Checking only Credible Variants in Region displays the variants that are present in both the the Variants in credible set section and the Variants in CS region ± 200 k section.
  • Checking only Annotations in Region displays all of the variants from the Variants in CS region ± 200 k section that are present in annotated regions in the selected tissue, as displayed in the Annotated regions section.
  • Checking both Credible Variants in Region and Annotations in Region displays the variants shared between these two summaries.
  • After changing your selections, click the Update summary button.
  • Click Save data/set table in the upper right to format and download the results.
